question: Did real GDP grow faster than 2% (annualized) in Q4 2018, i.e. was the annualized growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) from Q3 2018 to Q4 2018, 100 * ((level(Q4 2018) / level(Q3 2018))^4 - 1), above 2.0%?
notes: Definition: yes iff 100 * ((level(q) / level(q-1 quarter))^4 - 1) > 2.0, unrounded; a tie is no. Kept only if, in both vintages, |annualized QoQ growth - 2.0| >= 0.2 (percentage points; the annualized equivalent of the 0.05 non-annualized GDP margin). as_of_date = first release of the target observation; revision_date = first vintage >= 1 year later (else latest). annualized QoQ growth (%): as-of 2.589, revised 1.09.

question: Was December 2021 the weakest of the 12 months ending in December 2021 for payroll growth, i.e. was the monthly change in total nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) in December 2021 lower than in each of the 11 months before it?
